verdict.rationale: Maritime docs explicitly describe 'Computers': a persistent Linux desktop (XFCE, Chromium, LibreOffice) per user driven by a model, and the changelog confirms agents get a real Linux desktop with screenshot/mouse/keyboard control and live takeover — this covers full desktop environments including a browser (Chromium) inside the sandbox. missing for 10: no independent/hands-on corroboration of performance or headless-only browser mode, and no detail on resource limits or concurrency.
